args.subject: Refund Processed for Overbilling Correction
args.body:
Dear Adatum Ltd,

We have identified and corrected an overbilling error from last month where you were charged at the wrong plan tier. Your account has been updated to the correct **SILVER** tier, and a refund of **240** has been processed.

Please verify your next billing statement. If you have further questions, reply to this email.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
